messages:
maria-ng: quick heads-up — canary showing 20-40% p95 regressed after enabling INT4 CUTLASS path on sm86 nodes. noticed on long-context tests (avg seq ~1500).
kevin-w: ack. is it behavioral (quality) or perf-only?
maria-ng: perf-only so far, outputs look fine vs baseline. latency and GPU utilization patterns look odd — lots of short spikes.
jonas: uploaded a flamegraph. main diff is increased kernel-switching and a second-stage memcpy burst during kv cache refill. suspect alignment/packing in INT4 CUTLASS kernel causing more kv evictions.
perf-bot: perf snapshot: canary group int4-cutlass | p50=11ms p95=124ms p99=310ms | baseline int8-fp8 p95=88ms p99=220ms | kv-miss-rate = 0.18 | avg-gpu-util=72% -> 86%
sara-l: 0.18 kv-miss is high for our long-context workloads. CUTLASS path probably uses different cache layout (tensor cores + tile packing) — could increase KV size per entry.
kevin-w: if INT4 kernel increases per-entry KV footprint we should never route >1k seq to it. can we gate by seq length or kv hit ratio?
jonas: quick patch for selector heuristics:
```
kernel_selector.rules = [
  {when: seq_len > 1024 or kv_miss_rate > 0.12, prefer: ['fp8','int8']},
  {when: arch == 'sm86' and model.quant == 'int4' and seq_len <= 512, prefer: ['int4-cutlass']}
]
```
kevin-w: +1 to that, but need canary rollback first. ops-bot — can we flip the buildflag back for canary 42?
ops-bot: rollback job queued: rbx-deploy --env=canary --service=inference-runtime --tag=prev --wait
perf-bot: will re-run synthetic suite after rollback. expected rebaseline in ~6m.
maria-ng: also adding a microprofile of KV entry sizes across kernels. jonas, can you add a regression test for kv footprint threshold so future builds fail fast?
jonas: yup — will add a small unit that compares kv_entry_bytes per-key for int4 vs int8 and fails if >1.15x baseline.
sara-l: longer-term: adjust our kernel compilation flags to keep KV packing identical across implementations (padding control). that avoids surprise regressions when switching runtime toggles.
kevin-w: agree. for now we rollback canary and update selector heuristics. after rollback I'll cut a canary branch with gated rules and the kv-unit test.
maria-ng: thanks — triage notes: 1) rollback canary 2) add selector gate (seq+kv-miss) 3) kv footprint unit test 4) audit CUTLASS packing flags. assigned to kevin/jonas/sara.
ops-bot: rollback finished. canary now at tag prev. monitoring p95.
perf-bot: post-rollback metrics: canary p95=86ms, p99=205ms, kv-miss-rate=0.09.
maria-ng: good. follow-up PRs incoming. thx everyone :thumbsup:
